verdicts.reason: A keeps the owls at their original size, so the extra height reads as padding. Worse, the right owl's flat-cut body stops short of the bottom edge and leaves a white strip under it, so it looks clipped and floating. B scales the owls and the headline up to fill the taller canvas and keeps the right owl anchored to the bottom edge, so it looks deliberate. Its only small flaws are the purple star crowding the 'P' of PARTIES and the left owl's head cropping hard at the top.
